$comment: content/stops/*.json: a stop set (BUILD_PLAN S3; S9's cards and S15a's tailgate replace it). A stop has next (a stop in the set, or null for the set's end) or choices. A choice has then, a roll (S3: a p expression) or odds (S6: a base and labeled modifiers, priced by web/js/engine/odds.js; GAME_DESIGN 8.5, 8.8). box, label, view, fail_word and badly are display data (voice.json); the rest is logic (rules.json). From S6 a stop may walk (the clock moves by the router's time with 7.4's breaks: on Walk on, or on entering an outcome stop), foreshadow a danger a later choice needs (9.5), and be an outcome (its severity, 12.13; a death ends the set and the hiker).

box.$comment: One line, a list of variants for one slot, or a list of slots, each a list of variants; an empty list is a quiet stop, with no box at all (decision 32; GAME_DESIGN 12.2). (The empty list is its own branch, and the two lists need an item, so exactly one branch matches: tools/schema.mjs reads oneOf, not anyOf.)

view.$comment: Display data (x-voice: voice.json, never rules.json): pic, the picture (a place in content/art/recipes.json); node, the park node the caption and the strip read; day, today's route for the strip, its points in order (BUILD_PLAN S5).

walk.$comment: A walk the router times (engine/graph.js route, engine/movement.js withBreaks; GAME_DESIGN 7.4): from, through each via in order, to. On a stop with next it is Walk on's; on an outcome stop it is taken on entering it.

route.$comment: Where a rolled choice goes, for its Why sheet (12.11): the router's arrival there, and, with exposed_to, until when the same way stays on the open crest.

odds.$comment: A rolled choice (GAME_DESIGN 8.5, 8.8): base names a base in content/rules/odds.json, mods its labeled modifiers (a skill, at the hiker's level), clean and shaky the stops its two made-it bands go to, and fail its weighted fail table: each entry a stop, a weight and its rung on 9.1's ladder (one at rung 3 or more makes the choice a diamond: computed, never authored, 8.1), with at most one death roll (9.5: permille of that entry's fails, the stop it goes to, its cause key, and the gentle mode's stop instead).
